## Mechanism, named before code (card thread `session_01KCZSeNY7z5jAXn3EyHdZww`, branch `claude/project-thread-6rh8kd`)

**Choice: a formula over the related display names, read ONE hop through each lookup.** No stamp, no hook, no new formula capability.

**It already exists; nothing in `@objectstack/formula` is widened.** The one-hop formula read is on `main` since #24197 (ADR-0079 addendum 2026-10-18, items 1 to 4): `record.FIELD.RELATED` through a `lookup` is preloaded by the engine read path (`find`, `findOne`, the insert and update responses; `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` `formulaHopScope` / `resolveOneHopRelated`). The comment at `sys-business-unit-member.object.ts:33–35` ("a formula ... cannot reach a related record's own title") predates it and is stale. A sibling join object already titles itself this way: `sys_user_permission_set.display_title` (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/sys-user-permission-set.object.ts:77`), pinned by `sys-user-permission-set-person-title.test.ts`. I reuse that shape:

`(isBlank(trim(record.user_id.name)) ? record.user_id.email : record.user_id.name) + ' in ' + record.business_unit_id.name`

`name` is the declared title of both `sys_user` and `sys_business_unit` (`nameField: 'name'`, a stored required text column, so no second hop). The email arm is the platform's `name || email` rule for a person, the same one the sibling uses and the one the console's own embedded-lookup display applies.

**Cost on writes:** none. No stored column, no hook, no extra statement on insert or update of the membership, the user or the unit.

**Cost on reads:** two batched reads per page (one `sys_user`, one `sys_business_unit`, `$in` over the page's ids), never one per row, under the reader's own permissions. A `findOne` is two extra point reads. Reads that do not project `display_title` pay nothing.

**Rename reach:** total and immediate. Nothing is stamped, so a renamed user or unit shows the new name on the next read everywhere the title is served.

**Known limits (already true today, unchanged):** the title is not sortable or searchable (ADR-0079 addendum item 9; it is a formula over ids today and was already neither). A user or unit the reader may not read, or one that no longer exists, leaves the title `null` (addendum item 2), and the renderer falls to `titleFormat`.

**`titleFormat` and `display_title` keep agreeing.** `titleFormat` stays `{user_id} in {business_unit_id}`: the console renders a lookup placeholder by the embedded record's display name (`name`, else `email`), so over an expanded row it renders the same text as the formula. `identity-display-title.test.ts` will assert that over the row the hop serves.

Proceeding to red-first measurement and the change.
